definitions.content: Document that is signed by an individual OIML Issuing Authority, Utilizer or Associate, whereby it accepts to abide by the rules of the OIML-CS

notes.content: Note 1: The scope of certification is detailed in the individual Declaration for each OIML Issuing Authority, and the scope of acceptance of OIML type evaluation reports issued with an OIML certificate under Scheme A or B is detailed in the individual Declaration for each Utilizer and Associate.
Note 2: Each OIML Issuing Authority, Utilizer and Associate signs an individual Declaration under the OIML-CS.
